## Change / 修改

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. 说明具体问题与修改后的结果。

## Content and language / 内容与语言

For content changes, explain changes to sources, reasoning or scope, and confirm that both language editions were updated. 内容变更说明来源、判断或范围变化，并核对中英文同步。

## Verification / 验证

List commands actually run and their results, relevant manual checks, and any checks not completed. UI changes include screenshots. 写实际执行的检查及结果；页面变更附截图，说明未验证事项。
